title: Position Switch L4-2
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'position_switch', level 4, variant 2. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Both monsters begin in Defense Position; change to Attack, then attack directly.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Flip Catapult Turtle, and set Statue of the Wicked.
Attack Kangaroo Champ with Gyaku-Gire Panda. (2800 ATK - 800 ATK = 2000)
Activate Mystical Space Typhoon to destroy your facedown Statue of the Wicked.
When the Wicked Token is summoned, activate Token Feastevil. (300 x 4 + 300 x 3 = 2100)
finish the game by sacrificing your monsters for Turtles effect in Main Phase 2 (1/2 x (800+1000) = 900) for a total of 6000 damage.
Flip Catapult Turtle, and set Statue of the Wicked.
Activate Mystical Space Typhoon to destroy your facedown Statue of the Wicked and summon the Wicked Token
Attack Kangaroo Champ with Gyaku-Gire Panda (1300 ATK - 800 ATK = 500)
Attack directly with the Turtle and the token (1000 ATK + 1000 ATK = 2000)
sacrifice your monsters for Turtles effect in Main Phase 2 (1/2 x (800+1000+1000) = 1400)
When the Ojama Tokens are summoned, activate Token Feastevil (300 x 3 + 300 x 3 = 1800)
